title: Fees by duration
hints: To price a stay you need to know when it started. Where does the park timestamp live in your current design?
Store a small record per parked vehicle, e.g. a `@dataclass Stay` with `spot_id` and `parked_at`, instead of just the spot id. Keep a separate `dict[str, int]` of totals paid per plate.
Put the pricing in one helper, `fee(minutes)`, and call it from both `quote` and `leave` so they can never disagree.
Started hours without floats: `-(-minutes // 60)` or `(minutes + 59) // 60`. Then `0 if minutes <= 15 else 300 * started_hours`.
